promotion_requirements: Observed evidence matches the declared enforcement mode

components.name: baseline-rules
components.purpose: Keep a small invariant safety and truth baseline without claiming native enforcement.
components.compensation_hypothesis: A small stable baseline reduces drift without imposing a large context tax.
retirement_criteria: Native runtime enforcement replaces the same rules with live evidence.

components.name: governance-skills
components.purpose: Provide on-demand recovery, evaluation, context, memory, and orchestration procedures.
components.compensation_hypothesis: On-demand procedures reduce inconsistent reinvention while keeping Tier 0 small.
retirement_criteria: A verified native surface supersedes each skill.

components.name: agent-contracts
components.purpose: Separate maker, test author, test runner, reviewer, explorer, architect, and auditor authority.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Independent roles reduce correlated self-review and false completion.
retirement_criteria: Role separation fails to improve false-completion or scope metrics.

components.name: truth-registry
components.purpose: Reject phantom capabilities, unsupported verified claims, and stale components.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Truthful manifests prevent authoritative documentation from causing optimistic hallucination.
retirement_criteria: An equivalent runtime-owned capability registry provides stronger evidence.

components.name: bounded-execution-control
components.purpose: Constrain scope, persist resumable state, fingerprint workspaces, and make command evidence bounded.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Explicit contracts and monotonic state reduce overreach, drift, and duplicate side effects.
retirement_criteria: Behavioral evals show no improvement in overreach, retry, or resume safety.

components.name: verification-closure
components.purpose: Bind checks to current inputs and reserve verified for a deterministic completion gate.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Causal evidence and independent authority reduce false completion and stale verification.
retirement_criteria: Behavioral evals show no improvement in false-completion or evidence freshness.

components.name: attempt-truth
components.purpose: Persist every attempt and generate completion reports without model-selected omission.
components.compensation_hypothesis: A deterministic ledger prevents final summaries from hiding failed or rejected attempts.
retirement_criteria: Attempt reports fail to predict omitted failures in live canaries or a trusted native ledger supersedes them.

components.name: tier1-policy-routing
components.purpose: Keep GEMINI.md small and route qualifying work to the reliable-maker-control skill.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Moving the full policy pack out of global injection reduces context tax without weakening complex-task guidance.
retirement_criteria: Restart canaries show the skill is never loaded when required or global context savings do not materialize.

components.name: execution-provenance-audit
components.purpose: Require governed TaskRoot identity and canonical contract, ledger, report, claim, envelope, test-result, and decision producer metadata.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Producer hashes and required-chain audits expose phantom execution reports that omit contract, envelope, claim, or decision artifacts.
retirement_criteria: A native trusted execution log provides stronger unforgeable provenance.

components.name: behavioral-evals
components.purpose: Run repeatable truth, scope, recovery, verification, and governance regressions.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Repeatable failure cases prevent documentation-only improvements from being mistaken for reliability gains.
retirement_criteria: The suite fails to predict real Antigravity regressions or is superseded by a stronger native eval surface.

components.name: desktop-hook-probe
components.purpose: Antigravity Desktop opt-in guarded Binding, privacy-bounded Tool Operations, conservative unknown results and read-only recovery audit; strict unavailable.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Host-issued session/step metadata with explicit current authorization and durable observations raises reliability without claiming same-user isolation.
retirement_criteria: The desktop build does not load the documented hook contract or a safer host-native policy surface supersedes it.

components.name: sync-boundaries
components.purpose: Transactionally synchronize maintainable payloads while excluding runtime-private state.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Explicit source/runtime boundaries prevent credential leaks and accidental runtime corruption.
retirement_criteria: A native transactional package manager provides equivalent boundary and rollback guarantees.

components.name: knowledge-gate-adapter
components.purpose: Optional source-fidelity and canonical Final Claim Set mechanical gate; separate from global runtime and real vault installation.
components.compensation_hypothesis: Deterministic original hashes and propagation checks catch known false-completion patterns; native semantics remain an explicit separate evidence layer.
retirement_criteria: A host-native project knowledge gate provides stronger independently tested guarantees.

components.purpose: Transfer project ownership and exact evidence without lowering Antigravity acceptance.
components.compensation_hypothesis: A shared bounded handoff avoids lost context while asymmetric adapters preserve strict execution.
retirement_criteria: Native cross-engine coordination replaces this protocol with equivalent scope and evidence guarantees.
